text_block_list.text:
Constantly pondering why she runs, Winning 
Ticket realized she had lost the drive of 
"not wanting to lose."

She remembered that her dream was to win 
every race and deliver the "ultimate race" 
to the fans in the stands.

Grateful to Biwa Hayahide and Narita 
Taishin for reminding her of what truly 
mattered, Winning Ticket challenged them 
to a mock race.

Through that showdown, the two of them 
realized that the fiery Winning Ticket of 
old had returned.

And so, united once again as "BNW," the 
three were destined to clash at the 
year-end's greatest stage, the Arima 
Kinen.
